name: TiddlyWiki5 substituted attribute
comment:
A backtick-quoted attribute value, which getSubstitutedText expands. wiki.js takes exactly two forms there — an embedded filter and a variable reference — and reaches the parameter form only when a caller supplies substitutions, which a widget attribute never does.

The selector names the FAMILY rather than a member: the rules emit a width in the middle of the name, `single` for one backtick and `triple` for three, and a selector spelling out either one reaches only that one. Matching stops at dot boundaries, so a name carrying a segment the selector omits sits out of reach, paints nothing and reports nothing.

This stands as a grammar of its own so one registration reaches every scope that colours wikitext.
